source.climate: NASA POWER / MERRA-2 monthly point API; grid climate, not site measurements or river discharge.
source.methods: Annual values: unweighted means of 12 complete monthly means, using engine.annualSeriesFromPower. Climatology: mean of all 30 annual values, 1991-2020. Warming: engine.analyze T2M, Sen slope per decade and Hamed-Rao Mann-Kendall verdict, 1981 through the last complete calendar year. Each place is tested separately; no multiple-testing adjustment.
source.text: Original paraphrases of the cited Wikipedia revisions; CC BY-SA 4.0. Country lists describe whole features, except river countries explicitly refer to catalog points.
